description: Get flat list of all Elementor elements on a page (id, elType, widgetType, parent_id, depth, settings); easier to search/filter than the tree

el_type.description: Filter by element type (container, section, column, widget, or a V4 type like e-div-block)

fields.description: Comma-separated setting keys to keep in each element's settings (default: all)

widget_type.description: Filter by widget type (heading, button, image, text-editor, html, ...)

name: mcp_get_elementor_flat
